610596188600dba7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ادوية فاركو انترناشيونال عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والتأهيل للأنظمة الهندسية الحيوية داخل الشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مسؤولية الإشراف على مجموعة من المهام الهندسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة العمليات. تشمل هذه المسؤوليات: الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والتأهيل لأنظمة التكييف المركزي. التعامل مع ضواغط الهواء وغلايات البخار والمرافق الهندسية الأخرى. المهام التشغيلية تشمل المهام التشغيلية اليومية لهذا الدور مجموعة من الأنشطة الهندسية التي تضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على تطبيق المعرفة الهندسية في بيئة صناعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن شركة ادوية فاركو انترناشيونال. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في الحفاظ على كفاءة البنية التحتية الهندسية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى التقديم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد عملية التقييم.

61477722b7e8894f.description: About the Role ITHR Technologies Consulting is seeking a highly experienced SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Quality Assurance Consultant to support a large-scale SAP S/4HANA implementation program for a leading Oil & Gas organization in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. The consultant will join an Independent Quality Assurance (QA) team responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and validating SAP Group Reporting solutions and implementation deliverables developed by the System Integrator (SI). Key Responsibilities Independently review SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting solution designs, configurations, and functional specifications, ensuring alignment with business requirements, SAP leading practices, and IFRS reporting standards. Review System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies, test plans, execution results, and defect management. Assess Group Reporting data migration strategies, mapping, transformation, cleansing, and load procedures, validating data accuracy and reconciliation. Review cutover plans, deployment strategies, operational readiness, and post-Go-Live hypercare, recommending corrective actions. Identify functional, accounting, reporting, integration, testing, migration, and deployment risks, maintaining QA findings, risk registers, and issue logs. Qualifications and Experience Minimum 10+ years of SAP consulting experience, with extensive financial consolidation and SAP Group Reporting expertise. Minimum 5 end-to-end SAP implementation projects. At least 2 SAP implementations in the Oil & Gas, Midstream, Downstream, Petrochemical, or Energy sectors. Strong understanding of applicable IFRS consolidation and financial reporting requirements. Proven experience in independent quality assurance, solution reviews, design assurance, and implementation governance. Experience reviewing Solution Design Documents, functional specifications, system integration designs, SIT, UAT, data migration, financial reconciliation, cutover, and Go-Live readiness. Strong understanding of SAP Finance integration with Group Reporting. Ability to independently challenge solution designs, identify implementation risks, and recommend corrective actions. Willingness to work onsite in Saudi Arabia according to phase-wise project requirements. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA certification in Group Reporting, Financial Consolidation, or a related functional area. Previous experience as an SAP Group Reporting QA Consultant, Solution Assurance Consultant, Consolidation Lead, or Solution Architect. Experience on large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation or independent QA engagements in the GCC. Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and implementation quality gates. Familiarity with SAP Signavio, SAP Solution Manager, or SAP Cloud ALM. Experience with SAP Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) and SAP Group Reporting Data Collection. Knowledge of integration with non-SAP financial systems. Experience working with major System Integrators. Arabic language proficiency is an advantage. Expected Deliverables SAP Group Reporting Solution Design Review Reports Legal and Management Consolidation Assessment Reports Intercompany Reconciliation and Elimination Review Reports Currency Translation and Ownership Consolidation Assessments Group Reporting Data Integration and Mapping Reviews Design Assurance and Quality Gate Reports SIT and UAT Readiness Assessments Data Migration and Financial Reconciliation Review Reports Cutover and Go-Live Readiness Assessments QA Findings, Risk Registers, and Issue Tracking Logs Post-Go-Live Stabilization Review Reports Executive-Level QA Reports and Recommendations Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a senior SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting specialist with a combination of hands-on financial consolidation implementation expertise, IFRS knowledge, Oil & Gas industry experience, and independent quality assurance capabilities. Candidates must demonstrate experience with complex consolidation environments involving multiple legal entities, ownership structures, currencies, reporting hierarchies, and financial data sources. The successful consultant should be capable of independently assessing System Integrator deliverables and challenging consolidation designs.

This includes setting the target architecture for the group, encompassing ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric. Set the target architecture for the group, including ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric. Key Responsibilities Perform inspection, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of commercial and industrial chiller systems and associated HVAC equipment. Diagnose mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, and control-system faults, determining appropriate corrective actions. Carry out scheduled maintenance activities to maintain equipment reliability, efficiency, and performance. Service and maintain chillers, chilled-water systems, pumps, cooling towers, and associated HVAC equipment. Inspect operating pressures, temperatures, refrigerant circuits, and other critical operating parameters using test instruments. Identify refrigerant leaks and perform recovery, evacuation, charging, and related service activities in accordance with regulations. Inspect, test, and maintain compressors, motors, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, condenser and evaporator systems, controls, and safety devices. Troubleshoot electrical circuits, electronic controls, sensors, starters, variable-frequency drives, and other control components. Diagnose and adjust HVAC control systems and support building automation and control systems. Perform system start-up, shutdown, commissioning, testing, and performance checks. Analyze equipment operating conditions and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and energy efficiency. Maintain accurate service reports, maintenance records, equipment readings, and documentation. Provide technical guidance and support to junior technicians and field personnel. Maintain and use required personal protective equipment (PPE), tools, and company-issued equipment. Participate in on-call or emergency service rotations as required. Safety and Compliance Safety is a core principle at Carrier. The Senior Chiller Technician is expected to adhere to all safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements, as well as applicable local, national, and industry regulations. This includes identifying and mitigating workplace hazards, using appropriate PPE, maintaining technical certifications, and following proper refrigerant handling procedures. Maintaining a clean and safe work environment and participating in required safety training are also essential. Our Commitment Carrier values the expertise, creativity, and passion of its employees. The company is committed to providing a workplace that attracts, develops, and retains talent, fosters collaboration, and drives innovation to better serve customers. Carrier is guided by its values of Respect, Integrity, Inclusion, Innovation, and Excellence.
